title: Outcome Measurement
description: Outcome Measurement is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Measures outcomes so the loop has something to improve. Outcomes are defined before the loop runs; measurement is automatic. It takes system and produces metrics. Tunable parameters: per cycle. Guarantee: outcomes are never redefined mid-loop.

fields.mechanism: Outcomes are defined before the loop runs; measurement is automatic.

title: Error Signals
description: Error Signals is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Turns failures into clean error signals. Failures are classified and quantified; noise is filtered. It takes failures and produces signals. Tunable parameters: per failure. Guarantee: signals never include blame.

fields.mechanism: Failures are classified and quantified; noise is filtered.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Gradient Steps
description: Gradient Steps is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Improves parameters by small steps in the improving direction. Each cycle nudges parameters toward better outcomes; steps are bounded. It takes params and produces updated. Tunable parameters: bounded. Guarantee: steps never overshoot the bound.

fields.mechanism: Each cycle nudges parameters toward better outcomes; steps are bounded.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Exploration Budgets
description: Exploration Budgets is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Spends a fixed budget trying new approaches. A fraction of cycles explore randomly; the rest exploit the best known. It takes cycles and produces exploration. Tunable parameters: 10%. Guarantee: exploration never exceeds budget.

fields.mechanism: A fraction of cycles explore randomly; the rest exploit the best known.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Convergence Detection
description: Convergence Detection is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Detects when improvement stalls and stops the loop. No gain for N cycles declares convergence; the best params are kept. It takes history and produces signal. Tunable parameters: N=10. Guarantee: loops never run forever.

fields.mechanism: No gain for N cycles declares convergence; the best params are kept.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Human Checkpoints
description: Human Checkpoints is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Pauses for human approval at declared checkpoints. Checkpoints gate major changes; the loop waits for a decision. It takes plan and produces pauses. Tunable parameters: declared. Guarantee: checkpoints are never skippable.

fields.mechanism: Checkpoints gate major changes; the loop waits for a decision.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Rollback on Regress
description: Rollback on Regress is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Rolls back the moment a cycle makes things worse. Each cycle's outcome compares to baseline; regressions revert. It takes cycles and produces rollbacks. Tunable parameters: per cycle. Guarantee: regressions never persist.

fields.mechanism: Each cycle's outcome compares to baseline; regressions revert.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Metric Balance
description: Multi-Metric Balance is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Improves several metrics without sacrificing one. Pareto tracking keeps all metrics; dominated states are rejected. It takes metrics and produces balance. Tunable parameters: Pareto. Guarantee: no metric is ever sacrificed silently.

title: Learning Rate Schedules
description: Learning Rate Schedules is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Adjusts how fast the loop learns over time. Rates start high and decay; schedules adapt to noise. It takes cycles and produces rates. Tunable parameters: scheduled. Guarantee: rates never go negative.

title: Experiment Isolation
description: Experiment Isolation is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Runs experiments isolated from production. Candidates run on shadow traffic; production never sees unproven changes. It takes candidates and produces shadow. Tunable parameters: isolated. Guarantee: production is never the experiment.

Learned params and histories persist; restarts resume, not reset. It takes learning and produces stored. Tunable parameters: persistent. Guarantee: knowledge is never lost on restart.

title: Cold Starts

It takes similar systems and produces defaults. Tunable parameters: proven. Guarantee: cold starts never start from zero knowledge.

title: Loop Composition
description: Loop Composition is a optimization ability in the Self-Improving Feedback Loops database. Nests loops so fast loops feed slow loops. Inner loops tune daily params; outer loops tune strategy monthly. It takes loops and produces nested. Tunable parameters: 2 levels. Guarantee: loops never fight each other.
